name: Exp_ResonanceHunter
summary: This EA uses a multi-symbol Stochastic oscillator (MultiStochastic_Exp) to detect resonance signals across three correlated currency pairs simultaneously. It trades up to three independent strategy slots, each analyzing a triangle of currency pairs (e.g., EURUSD/EURJPY/USDJPY) for Stochastic-based buy/sell signals and stop signals. Positions are opened and closed based on these cross-pair momentum resonance conditions with fixed stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用多品种随机指标（MultiStochastic_Exp）同时检测三个相关货币对的共振信号。它最多可运行三个独立策略槽，每个槽分析一组三角货币对（如EURUSD/EURJPY/USDJPY）的随机指标买卖信号和停止信号。基于这些跨品种动量共振条件开仓和平仓，并设置固定止损。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于跨品种随机指标共振，即当三个相关货币对的Stochastic指标同时发出同方向信号时，认为市场存在更强的动量趋势。入场条件为MultiStochastic_Exp指标的信号线值等于300时触发买入或卖出信号，这是一个特殊标记值而非传统超买超卖阈值。出场条件包括止损触发和反向停止信号，其中止损为固定点数（默认500点），无止盈设置。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认0.1手），无加仓减仓机制。资金管理方面完全没有风险控制，没有账户余额检查、没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤保护。该策略同时监控三组三角套利组合（EUR/JPY/USD、GBP/JPY/USD、AUD/JPY/USD），利用货币对之间的相关性寻找共振机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on cross-pair Stochastic resonance, where simultaneous Stochastic signals from three correlated currency pairs indicate a stronger momentum trend. Entry conditions trigger when the MultiStochastic_Exp indicator's signal buffer value equals 300, which is a special marker value rather than a traditional overbought/oversold threshold. Exit conditions include stop-loss triggers and opposing stop signals, with a fixed stop-loss of 500 points by default and no take-profit set. Position sizing uses fixed lots (default 0.1) with no scaling, martingale, or position adjustment mechanisms. Money management is essentially absent — there is no account balance check, no maximum position limit, and no drawdown protection. The strategy monitors three triangular arbitrage groups (EUR/JPY/USD, GBP/JPY/USD, AUD/JPY/USD) simultaneously, exploiting currency pair correlations to find resonance opportunities.

pros: 多品种共振策略理念独特，利用三角货币对相关性增强信号可靠性
每组策略可独立启用/禁用，灵活性较好
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
多品种时间同步检查（SynchroCheck）确保数据一致性
止损设置有最小止损级别保护，防止因止损过近被拒绝
pros_en: Multi-symbol resonance strategy concept is unique, leveraging triangular currency pair correlations to enhance signal reliability
Each strategy slot can be independently enabled/disabled, providing good flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Multi-symbol time synchronization check (SynchroCheck) ensures data consistency across pairs
Stop-loss includes minimum stop level protection to prevent rejection due to stops being too close
cons: 完全没有止盈设置，盈利完全依赖止损或反向信号出场，可能导致盈利大幅回吐
使用ORDER_FILLING_FOK填充模式，在流动性不足时容易导致订单被拒绝
缺少账户资金检查，下单前不验证可用保证金是否充足
没有持仓数量限制，三组策略可能同时开仓导致风险集中
代码中deviation赋值逻辑有冗余（deviation==ULONG_MAX? deviation : deviation），始终返回原值
依赖外部自定义指标MultiStochastic_Exp，增加部署复杂度和依赖风险
cons_en: No take-profit setting at all — profits rely entirely on stop-loss or opposing signals, potentially leading to significant profit givebacks
Uses ORDER_FILLING_FOK fill mode which can cause order rejections when liquidity is insufficient
No account balance/margin check before placing orders, risking margin call scenarios
No position count limit — all three strategies could open simultaneously, concentrating risk
Redundant deviation assignment logic (deviation==ULONG_MAX? deviation : deviation) always returns the original value
Depends on external custom indicator MultiStochastic_Exp, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
improvements: 增加止盈参数和追踪止损功能，实现更完善的盈利保护和出场机制
增加账户资金检查、最大持仓限制和回撤保护，完善资金管理
将ORDER_FILLING_FOK改为更兼容的填充模式，或根据品种自动选择合适的填充策略
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免高成本和低流动性时段交易
将三组重复的输入参数重构为数组或结构体，减少代码冗余并支持动态扩展策略槽数量
improvements_en: Add take-profit parameter and trailing stop functionality for better profit protection and exit management
Add account balance checks, maximum position limits, and drawdown protection for proper money management
Change ORDER_FILLING_FOK to a more compatible fill mode or auto-select fill policy based on symbol
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid high-cost and low-liquidity periods
Refactor three sets of duplicate input parameters into arrays or structs to reduce code redundancy and support dynamic strategy slot expansion

risk_points: 无止盈设置，盈利仓位可能大幅回吐
无账户资金检查，可能因保证金不足导致订单失败或爆仓
三组策略同时开仓可能导致风险集中过度暴露
依赖外部指标MultiStochastic_Exp，指标缺失时策略完全失效
FOK填充模式在高波动市场可能导致频繁订单拒绝
risk_points_en: No take-profit means winning positions can give back significant gains
No account balance check could lead to margin call or order failures
Three strategies opening simultaneously could cause excessive risk concentration
Dependence on external indicator MultiStochastic_Exp means total strategy failure if indicator is missing
FOK fill mode may cause frequent order rejections in volatile markets
